clips.title: The story
paras: The Furlbrows are stranded near Westfall's border, and their land deed is in Defias hands. The paper bears Theodore and Verna Furlbrow's claim to their family farm, while the couple waits by their broken wagon.

The deed bears Theodore Furlbrow's signature and Verna's as well, securing their family farm in Westfall. When the Defias Brotherhood overran the region, bandits drove the couple from their home and carried the paper into Elwynn Forest. Notes on its back show they meant to copy it when forging claims to other properties. The Furlbrows lost their home and livelihood, then took to the road. Their wagon broke near the border, leaving them stranded.
